parsed.note_claim: The Sagrada Família is not fully complete; the central Tower of Jesus Christ was finished in 2026, but the Glory Façade and other elements remain unfinished.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Sagrada Família may now appear complete, but it is far from done. With the Tower of Jesus Christ now built — notwithstanding the interior, which is expected to be finished by 2028 — attention has turned to the Glory Facade.
parsed.reason: The CNN article states the Tower of Jesus Christ is built but the basilica is unfinished, with the interior and the Glory Façade still to be completed.
